title: Cynthia Martin
description: They spoke about it in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK, but we never saw it — until now: Han Solo wins the Millennium Falcon from Lando Calrissian in a card game. "Seeing the movie when I was 15 was like beng transcended onto another level of being," remembers Cynthia Martin. "What a ride!" Martin's impressive work includes the original STAR WARS  comic for Marvel, a PUNISHER graphic novel and JASON GOES TO HELL for Topps Comics.
